description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateAttachmentAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing candidate attachment data within the recruitment module of the Human Resource Management system OrangeHRM. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and updating candidate attachments, with validation rules and documentation annotations.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing candidate attachments, including creation, retrieval, and update functionalities with validation and documentation annotations.
